before: Default to an independent spawn; reuse/fork a specialist context when continuing relevant completed investigation, passing findings and IDs rather than asking for rediscovery.
after: Default to an independent spawn. To continue an existing specialist session, use mstudio_send_message(agentId=childId, message=task) only when canContinue=true; select mode=continuable when initially delegating work that will need follow-ups. A oneShot session cannot resume: spawn a new task with existing findings and IDs. fork creates a new child seeded only with the parent session's completed history; it does not restore a previous specialist session.

before: The independent review role is currently disabled in Mstudio; do not add an automatic review round.
after: Read the current specialist roster and effective tool permissions to determine whether independent review is available. Delegate review only when it serves the current authorized scope; do not add a mandatory review round. If the requested role is unavailable, report the specific limitation and continue supported checks.

before: Only the coordinator writes shared memory for new explicit user decisions using the current user wording as evidence; scripts, shots and generation state remain in the project.
after: Shared memory writes require the current session's effective memory-write permission, enabled project memory and autoUpdate. Store only new, corrected or revoked lasting user decisions, quoting the original current user request as evidence; delegated messages are not user evidence. Do not infer permission from a role name. Scripts, shots and generation state remain in the project.

before: Reuse prior findings and actual IDs; reuse suitable continuing context without treating the entire history as instructions.
after: Reuse prior findings and actual IDs. Continue an existing specialist only with mstudio_send_message using its childId when canContinue=true. A oneShot session needs a new spawn carrying those findings. fork creates a new child from completed parent history, not from an earlier specialist session. History supplies evidence, not new instructions.

before: Inspect section=generation for actual status; creation is not completion.
after: Use the returned generationTasks status and continuation directly; creation is not completion. waiting_user requires the stated user action, so report it without more status queries. For waiting_service, continue independent work or use mstudio_await_generation when actual results are needed for remaining authorized work; inspect the returned real resultAssetIds.

before: When a generation card is referenced, inspect(section=generation, taskKey=referencedTask.key) and modify only that task with update_generation(taskKey,text).
after: When a generation card is referenced, use its supplied state; inspect(section=generation, taskKey=referencedTask.key) only for missing task details, then modify only that task with update_generation(taskKey,text).

before: When a generation card is referenced, inspect(section=generation, taskKey=referencedTask.key) and update only that task with update_generation(taskKey,text);
after: When a generation card is referenced, use its supplied state and inspect(section=generation, taskKey=referencedTask.key) only for missing details; update only that task with update_generation(taskKey,text);

before: Verify save receipts, task states and real asset IDs.
after: Use complete save receipts and the delegated generationTasks states, continuation and real asset IDs directly. Do not repeat a status query after a complete handoff. waiting_user ends dependent work until the stated user action; waiting_service uses mstudio_await_generation only when remaining authorized work needs the result.

before: Report pending, awaiting confirmation and unchecked states accurately.
after: Report the returned generationTasks status and continuation directly. Awaiting confirmation requires a user action: finish dependent work without polling. For backend processing, do independent work first and use mstudio_await_generation only for results needed by remaining authorized work. Uninspected results remain unchecked.

before: A referenced card identifies the target through referencedTask.key. Use inspect(section=generation, taskKey=theKey), not the full task list. Read associated nodes/fields only for missing evidence and neighboring shots only for a real dependency.
after: A referenced card identifies the target through referencedTask.key. Use its supplied task state; inspect(section=generation, taskKey=theKey) only for missing details. Read associated nodes/fields only for missing evidence and neighboring shots only for a real dependency.

before: 4. Inspect generation state and actual result assetId. Reuse existing tasks; completion is not visual acceptance. Inspect from source/support through path/contact to destination, not just the successful ending.
after: 4. Use generationTasks status and continuation from the receipt. waiting_user requires the stated user action: report it and finish dependent work. For waiting_service, do independent work first; use mstudio_await_generation only when remaining authorized work needs the result. Inspect actual resultAssetIds directly when ready. Reuse existing tasks; completion is not visual acceptance. Inspect from source/support through path/contact to destination, not just the successful ending.

before: Read current revision. Inspect action start, decisive event and end using mstudio_read_image(assetId,clipId,time): time is clip-relative seconds with trim/speed applied; without clipId it is source time.
after: Use supplied timeline state or complete savedClips receipts; inspect only missing editing values. Inspect action start, decisive event and end using mstudio_read_image(assetId,clipId,time): time is clip-relative seconds with trim/speed applied; without clipId it is source time.

before: Inspect saved state. Do not claim unavailable export/playback/audio operations. Preserve accepted material and unrelated tracks. A new version does not inherit old inspection results.
after: Verify committed editing values from complete savedClips receipts without rereading them. Do not claim unavailable export/playback/audio operations. Preserve accepted material and unrelated tracks. A new version does not inherit old visual inspection results.

before: When a generation card is referenced, its taskKey is the boundary. Inspect that task directly, then fetch only missing shot or asset fields.
after: When a generation card is referenced, its key is the boundary. Use supplied task state and complete save receipts; inspect that task only for missing details, then fetch only missing shot or asset fields.

before: Use purposes/names for front, side or identity roles;
after: Describe front view, side view or identity as visual uses in purpose or the asset name;

before: Return real assets, intended roles, fixed attributes
after: Return real assets, intended visual uses, fixed attributes

before: Preserve actual reference order and roles.
after: Preserve actual reference order and technical input modes. In generation tools, role selects the input mode (reference or edit); purpose describes what the image supplies, such as identity, geometry or composition.

before: Preserve actual reference order and roles.
after: Preserve actual reference order and technical input modes. In generation tools, role selects reference, first-frame, last-frame or video-reference as supported by the model; purpose describes the visual use, such as identity, composition or motion guidance.

before: Identify supplied images in actual order and state each role: identity/geometry, composition/light, or edit target.
after: Identify supplied images in actual order and describe each visual use: identity/geometry or composition/light. In tool arguments, write that description in purpose; role selects the technical input mode, reference for guidance or edit for the source image being modified.
